metadata.case_name: MAK SZE YING, FELIX v. CHUI CHAK YUNG T/A SILVER SPIRIT CAR SERVICES CENTER AND ANOTHER

injuries.description: the 1st defendants dog (a Doberman Pinscher) bit the 1st defendants left hand and wrist, causing it to bleed and swell.
source: he was picking up the car polishing machine, the 1st defendants dog (a Doberman Pinscher) bit the 1st defendants left hand and wrist, causing it to bleed and swell.
injuries.icd_description: Open bite of other parts of wrist or hand

injuries.description: Dr Chun considered the plaintiffs wounds were superficial
source: Dr Chun considered the plaintiffs wounds were superficial, he found the subsequent development of numbness and claw hands with supple joints of the digits cannot be explained.
injuries.icd_description: Superficial injury of other parts of wrist or hand

source: All these features are compatible with Complex Region Pain Syndrome.

injuries.description: adjustment disorder with mixed anxiety and depressed mood
source: Drs Lai and Ho agreed the plaintiff suffered from adjustment disorder with mixed anxiety and depressed mood.

injuries.description: Left hand deformity in claw hand position. Unable to extend fingers actively.
source: Left hand deformity in claw hand position. Unable to extend fingers actively.
injuries.icd_description: Injury of ulnar nerve at wrist or hand level

manifestations.description: persistent pain of his left hand and wrist
pin-prickness and numbness of his left hand and wrist
inability to flex and extend the fingers in his left hand
muscle wasting (mild) at the abductor pollicis brevis (APB) of the left thumb and marginal wasting at the first dorsal interosseous muscle of the left hand
reduced sensation to light touch over dorsum of the left hand and fingers and reduced sensation over left palm and digits (various percentages recorded)
numbness over the dorsum of left hand
decreased temperature noted on the dorsum of the left hand
fisting of left hand: Nearly full with pain
full passive extension of left fingers could not be achieved with active resistance; complained of pain on finger extension
poor opposition of the left thumb
unable to open the fingers to grip the handle (poor grip performance)
insomnia and nightmares of being bitten by a dog or other people with flashbacks of the accident and fleeting suicidal idea
depressive symptoms (adjustment disorder with mixed anxiety and depressed mood)
difficulties in lifting heavy objects using his left hand, holding a teapot and wringing towels using his left hand
reduction in left arm and forearm girth
widespread numbness, tenderness and reduced sensation of the left upper limb

source: After assessment by the doctor on duty at the Accident and Emergency Department, he was given an anti-tetanus injection. His wound was dressed and he was discharged.
After assessment by the doctor on duty at the Accident and Emergency Department, he was given an anti-tetanus injection. His wound was dressed and he was discharged.

treatments_received.treatment: attendance at the Accident and Emergency Department of Pok Oi Hospital 10 times between 6 July 2008 and 4 August 2008
source: The plaintiff attended the Accident and Emergency Department of Pok Oi Hospital 10 times between 6 July 2008 and 4 August 2008 due to persistent pain, pin-prickness and numbness of his left hand and wrist and inability to flex and extend the fingers in his left hand.

treatments_received.treatment: referral to the Department of Orthopaedics and Traumatology of Pok Oi Hospital for further management on 11 August 2008
source: He was referred to the Department of Orthopaedics and Traumatology of Pok Oi Hospital for further management on 11 August 2008.

treatments_received.treatment: occupational therapy at POH from 13 August 2008 to 23 October 2008
source: He received occupational therapy at POH from 13 August 2008 to 23 October 2008.

treatments_received.treatment: physiotherapy treatments for his left hand from 10 September to 15 October 2008 for a total of 18 sessions
source: He also received physiotherapy treatments for his left hand from 10 September to 15 October 2008 for a total of 18 sessions.

treatments_received.treatment: psychiatric treatment at Tuen Mun Mental Health Centre and follow up at Castle Peak Hospital
source: He was referred to the Tuen Mun Mental Health Centre for treatment on 2 September 2008. He was diagnosed to be suffering from post-traumatic stress disorder and depressive episode and has been followed up at the Tuen Mun Mental Health Centre and Castle Peak Hospital.

treatments_future.treatment: further psychiatric treatments and marital therapy from social workers
source: Both doctors considered a period of further treatments and marital therapy from social workers would be beneficial to the plaintiff.

losses.description: Pain, suffering and loss of amenities (general pain and ongoing left hand symptoms)
